headword: {七味唐辛子|しちみとうがらし}

definitions.explanation: A Japanese seasoning of ground red chili mixed with six other ingredients such as sansho pepper, sesame, orange peel and seaweed; sprinkled on noodles, soups and grilled food.

examples.japanese: ⟦うどん→うどん：05182_udon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{七味唐辛子|しちみとうがらし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かける。
⟦{牛丼|ぎゅうどん}→牛丼：08600_gyuudon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{七味唐辛子|しちみとうがらし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{欠|か}かせない→欠かす：10138_kakasu⟧。
examples.english: Shichimi is a must on a beef bowl.

examples.japanese: {七味唐辛子|しちみとうがらし}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{唐辛子|とうがらし}→唐辛子：11871_tougarashi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{山椒|さんしょう}→山椒：12412_sanshou⟧やごま⟦など→〜など：03095_nado⟧⟦{六|むっ}つ→六つ：02974_muttsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{材料|ざいりょう}→材料：02831_zairyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{混|ま}ぜて→混ぜる：02423_mazeru⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: Shichimi is made by mixing chili with six ingredients such as sansho pepper and sesame.

notes:
Usually shortened to ⟦{七味|しちみ}→七味：20131_shichimi⟧. Shops and noodle stands keep it on the table beside the soy sauce.
